scope: legacy photo-date selection and manifest-backed USB output reshuffle
sources_relied_upon: Existing pipeline, CLI, manifest schema, and output grouping logic
Configured USB output and iCloud source paths
material_decisions: Capture-date selection now prefers embedded EXIF, then validated machine-readable and human-readable filename dates, then folder dates, and only then filesystem time.
Manifest CSV retains canonical_date and adds capture_date with an explicit date_source.
The reshuffle command uses recorded EXIF decisions plus manifest paths and does not reopen cloud source files.
The reshuffle constructs a complete replacement photos tree before replacing the current output.
validation_performed: Verified document sample filename parsing for 2016, 2008, and 2009 dates.
open_questions: The active OneDrive-backed reshuffle must finish staging before the USB photos directory is replaced.
recommended_next_step: Confirm the active reshuffle completed, then inspect manifest.csv date_source and corrected playback folders before using the USB output.
